scope: Read-only review of the new Asteroids reserved launcher, scorer and protocol before their source/metadata commits. No production seal check, emulator construction, reserved capture or reserved data access was performed.
self_metadata_note: The future seal has8 metadata paths, including this receipt. This receipt hashes the other7; the seal must hash the final bytes of this receipt after writing.

checks.scoring_identity: AST equality confirmed for complete stats initialization, example/history initialization, per-frame loop and finalizer between development and reserved calibrators. Only reserved admission, all-seal source provenance and result seal binding differ. There are no category exemptions or changes to all-frame/positive-frame denominators, minimum50,99% criteria, ROI or matching.
checks.capture_identity: Launcher calls unchanged capture_cold_v70 for asteroid seed17512,8192frames,episode_limit108000. Source fixes uniform PythonRandom(117512) actions held16 raw frames, mode0,.25sticky and cold132 charges. No alternative capture branch, controller, seed selection or restore is introduced.
checks.proof_before_construction: verify_seal precedes the exclusive attempt file and capture call. Imports do not construct ALE. The attempt is written before the capture routine creates its engine; any existing destination, attempt or result refuses recollection.
checks.source_and_metadata: verify_seal requires exact31-source and8-metadata SHA dictionaries, fixed seed17512, Python version,4package versions and ALE binary SHA. It checks source_commit ancestry, every source/metadata/seal blob at HEAD and every source blob at source_commit. Engine separately checks declared ROM MD5 and ALE binary before loadROM.
checks.post_capture: Seal is checked again immediately after capture. Charged frames must equal8192+132*cold_loads and stay within1089668, with no restores/experiments. Captured manifest SHA and accounting are recorded before scoring.
checks.reserved_admission: Genuine verify_fixture_attempt requires the declared destination, captured/scoring/complete attempt state, seed17512, identical seal SHA and manifest SHA, and matching ALE binary. Reserved scorer additionally enforces every declared manifest parameter, exact capture provenance and strict contiguous shard/ledger validation.
checks.failure_preservation: Constructor, capture, accounting, seal and scorer exceptions are caught as BaseException; the sole mutable attempt records failed status and error. Raw files are not deleted. A failed/existing attempt blocks a second capture. Result publication is exclusive and follows post-scoring seal verification.
checks.stop: A completed result records independent_scientific_review_required. Calibration PASS does not authorize training, substitute seeds or tuning on the reserved archive.

The complete verify_seal control flow is exercised by provided synthetic tests, including source/metadata/runtime/seed/HEAD/source_commit/seal_blob/ancestry failures; its production invocation requires the forthcoming commits/seal.

limits: This is an implementation review, not the real committed --check result. The source commit and metadata/seal commit must exist before root runs the real --check and then the single attempt.
Operational tests replace capture/scoring with synthetic functions and data in temporary directories; they never instantiate ALE or inspect17512.

All known development residuals and shared glyph-model limits from visible_composition_preseal_review.json remain. Reserved results must retain all images and be reviewed before any scientific conclusion.
The attempt is the sole mutable record; preexisting artifacts deliberately block automatic recovery or recollection. Scoring exceptions preserve the raw archive for diagnosis.
